Nexus Mods v1 API responses for the mock server in `tests/nexus_mock.rs`.

Field names and shapes follow the Nexus Mods API specification and the
types in Nexus Mods' own client library (`node-nexus-api`, `src/types.ts`:
`IUpdateEntry`, `IModFiles`, `IFileInfo`, `IMD5Result`, `IChangelogs`).
The values are made up; requests needing an API key weren't recorded.
